conversationalSummary.text: TODAY looks like a probably skip for Peniche—there isn’t really a reliable window, and even the best option (Rey Cortiço around lunch) is more “worth checking” than worth committing to. The wind looks like the main problem, with gusts that could easily chop things up, and Surfline in particular is coming in poor. I’d check Surfline and the MEO Beachcam first before you leave; unless the cams show it cleaned up way better than expected, I’d save the drive.
